title: GG Encounter Lens
description: Party-aware encounter analysis for D&D 5e. Instead of one difficulty number, it reads your party's real damage types, save spread, reach and defences, cross-references them against the monsters' stat blocks, and hands the GM a plain-language briefing of mismatches: what will hurt them and why. Part of the GegesVTT family. — Análisis de encuentros consciente del grupo para D&D 5e: en vez de un número de dificultad, un informe legible de desajustes entre tu party real y los monstruos.
